title: Glowing kite
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='kiteGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5a7a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb347'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow halo behind kite -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='30' ry='34' fill='#ff9a3c' opacity='0.18'/>
  <!-- kite diamond body -->
  <polygon points='50,8 78,38 50,72 22,38' fill='url(#kiteGrad)'/>
  <!-- kite panel highlights -->
  <polygon points='50,8 64,23 50,38 36,23' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.9'/>
  <polygon points='36,23 50,38 50,72 22,38' fill='#ff4f8b' opacity='0.65'/>
  <polygon points='64,23 78,38 50,72 50,38' fill='#ff7f3f' opacity='0.65'/>
  <!-- cross spars, light not dark -->
  <line x1='50' y1='8' x2='50' y2='72' stroke='#fff4c2' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='22' y1='38' x2='78' y2='38' stroke='#fff4c2' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- tail ribbons -->
  <path d='M50,72 Q46,80 54,86 Q60,91 52,96' fill='none' stroke='#7fe6ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='80' r='2.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='90' r='2.5' fill='#7fe6ff'/>
  <!-- little bows on tail -->
  <polygon points='50,76 57,74 55,80' fill='#ff5a7a'/>
  <polygon points='50,76 43,74 45,80' fill='#ffb347'/>
</svg>
